title: Missiles, drones and warships: Iran threatens to wipe out US from Middle East
description: Iran has warned it could wipe out US forces in the Middle East. The threat comes amid Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s visit to Washington. The United States has vowed not to back down, while Iran has deployed hundreds of drones and positioned missiles across the region.

title: US signs civil nuclear deal with Iran’s neighbour and Russia’s ally: What is 123 agreement?
description: The United States has reached a landmark civil nuclear deal with Armenia, allowing the country access to nuclear technology, equipment and fuel. The agreement reduces Armenia’s reliance on Russia and Iran while opening new avenues for energy cooperation.

title: Trump Predicts Iran's Willingness for a Nuclear Deal
description: U.S. President Donald Trump expressed confidence that Iran is inclined to negotiate a deal with the United States concerning its nuclear and ballistic missile programs. He emphasized the futility of any refusal to engage in such negotiations during an appearance on Fox Business Network's 'Kudlow' program.

title: US-Iran tension: Which American military bases are within Tehran's ballistic missile strike range - see them all
description: Rising tensions between Iran and the United States have drawn attention to Iran’s ballistic missile capabilities, which could reach several American military bases, including Al Udeid in Qatar and Ain al-Asad in Iraq.

title: Will the United States Attack Iran?
description: Tehran is threatening to “regionalize the war” if Washington uses force.

title: Netanyahu to meet Trump with Iran missiles high on agenda
description: JERUSALEM — Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will meet United States President Donald Trump in Washington on Wednesday, seeking to press him to adopt a tougher line on Iran’s ballistic missile program in the next round of talks.

title: Turkish FM says no immediate threat of US-Iran war as Turkey works to prevent escalation
description: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said there is currently no sign of an imminent war between the United States and Iran, stressing that Turkey is making efforts to prevent any escalation in the …

title: Iran Says Nuclear Talks Gauged 'Seriousness' of US
description: Nuclear talks with the United States allowed Tehran to gauge Washington's seriousness and showed enough consensus to continue on the diplomatic track, Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson said on Tuesday.

title: Oman Mediates Critical U.S.-Iran Nuclear Negotiations
description: Iran and the United States, with Oman's mediation, held discussions to seek a 'balanced and just' agreement. The talks follow heightened tensions due to U.S. naval deployment and Iran's crackdown on protests. Both nations aim to avert military conflict and address regional security issues.

title: Top Iranian adviser visits mediator Oman, as Iran and US prepare for talks
description: DUBAI, Feb 10 - A top adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader discussed ways to reach a \"balanced and just\" agreement with the United States during talks in Oman on Tuesday, as Washington and Tehran prepare to resume negotiations aimed at averting a new conflict. Read more at straitstimes.com.
